analysis.method: Viewed overview (20 frames), the transitions sheet (all 6 boundaries, every 2nd frame = 30 fps for this 60 fps file), the audio panel and the listen sheet (10 accent hits); 30 fps strips 0.30-1.60, 1.75-2.75, 4.05-4.60, 5.40-6.00, 6.40-7.20, 7.60-8.40, 10.85-11.40 and 11.55-12.45 s, plus 4.55-5.45 s (15 fps), 8.40-10.90 s (12 fps) and 12.45-15.00 s (6 fps); automated audio and listen metrics (signal features; Windows desktop dictation for speech; nothing was listened to).
analysis.coverage: Full 15.0 s with no gap; every boundary and every transformation at 12-30 fps.

concept.observed: A technique reel on black with a yellow accent dot: a dot rolls along a line that draws ahead of it, a word rises from the line, the camera flies through a letter into chrome rings, the rings become a cage, then a sphere that cracks with light and bursts into particles, the particles form a word, the word twists into a point that bursts into ink, the ink swallows and returns a word, and the three words stack into a closing statement whose full stop is the dot.
concept.interpreted: Each transition is the previous object becoming the next (line, ring, sphere, dust, ink); the dot is the thread.

communication_style.observed: Three single words, then a three-line statement in a tall condensed sans; HUD corner marks; no voice.

palette.observed: Black (#080808, 63%) with chrome greys and one yellow accent (dot, glow, ink); mean luma 0.17.

typography.observed: Tall condensed sans in white; earlier words switch to a grey particle texture as the last word arrives.

shapes_and_materials.observed: Chrome rings, a glowing wire cage, a ribbed matte sphere with glowing cracks, particles, yellow and grey ink.

camera.observed: Fly-through of a letter's counter (2.18-2.52 s); slow orbit around the rings (2.5-4.1 s).

transitions.observed: Ten changes, six detected as boundaries. (1) 0.30-0.73 s the dot rolls and the line draws ahead of it (continuous). (2) 0.97-1.30 s the first word rises from behind the line, letters staggered (continuous; the line is the mask). (3) 1.94 s the baseline flickers off and on (soft boundary, no scene change). (4) 2.18-2.52 s the camera flies through the O's counter into rings in 0.35 s (grow, zoom-through). (5) 4.12-4.35 s a large blurred ring sweeps across the lens while the rings close into a cage behind it (boundary 4.30 s; cover, foreground occluder). (6) 4.55-5.02 s the glowing cage becomes a solid ribbed sphere (continuous material morph). (7) 5.53-5.66 s the cracks brighten until the frame is nearly white, then a cut to a particle field (boundary 5.65 s; cut, flash). (8) 6.62-6.90 s particles converge into a word (boundary 6.65 s; continuous). (9) 7.70-8.06 s the word twists into a vortex, collapses to a ball and a point, and the point bursts into ink (boundary 7.88 s; grow, implode then burst). (10) 10.40-11.29 s ink pulls the second word apart and it re-forms (boundary 11.12 s; continuous). Then 11.42-12.05 s the words stack and dim as the last word rises from the returning line, and 12.08-12.45 s the dot flies in and lands as the full stop (continuous). Families: 1 cut, 2 grow, 1 cover, the rest continuous.
transitions.interpreted: A catalogue of transformations where nothing is wiped away: every new scene is the old object changing state, so 15 s of variety reads as one thought.

depth_and_layering.observed: A blurred foreground ring passes the lens (4.12-4.35 s); depth of field on the rings; HUD frame on top.

sound_design.observed: -16.0 LUFS, LRA 3.9 LU, true peak -2.3 dBTP; tempo estimate 129 bpm (low); 10 accents (40/min) at 0.16, 0.51 and 0.77 s (the rolling dot), 1.46 s (the word settles), 3.81 s (rings twist), 4.27 s (the foreground pass), 5.69 s (the burst), 11.77 s (the last word starts to rise), 12.24 s (the dot lands) and 14.12 s. 5 of 6 boundaries within 50 ms of an onset (0.83, chance 0.27, median 34 ms), the strongest alignment in batch-3; 2 of 6 carry an accent (4.30 and 5.65 s; 0.33, chance 0.12); no silences; head 5.6 dB and tail 6.2 dB below the body. Accents may be part of the music.
sound_design.interpreted: Each object change is placed on a musical event, and the two biggest transformations get the strongest accents.

narration.observed: None: dictation kept 0 words (10 raw words) over music.
narration.interpreted: Text-led film: the copy is on screen, timed to the music.

captions.observed: None; the copy is three giant centred words, then a left-aligned three-line stack.

motifs.observed: The yellow dot draws the line, sits in the O and lands as the full stop.

scenes.observed: The dot rolls and the line draws.
The first word rises from the line.
Rings become a cage, then a sphere that cracks with light.
The word twists into a point.
Ink billows; the third word sharpens, dissolves and re-forms.
The words stack; the last rises; the dot lands.

moments.observed: The word twists into a vortex with rotational blur (7.70-7.86 s), shrinks to a glowing ball (7.90 s) and a point (7.97 s), and the point bursts into yellow and grey ink (8.00-8.40 s).
moments.interpreted: Collapse before release makes the next scene feel caused.

moments.observed: The sphere's cracks brighten for 0.1 s until the frame is mostly white (5.62 s); the next frame is a particle field (5.66 s), with an accent at 5.69 s.
